current_activity: 9th Panzer Division command post at Fresnay-sur-Sarthe came under fire from the U.S. XV Corps and withdrew north
notes: Event date: Breakout and Pursuit ch. 25 p. 498 puts the LXXXI Corps defending the le Mans-Alençon axis on 10 August with the 708th and 9th Panzer Divisions in line; p. 500: the command posts of the 9th Panzer and Panzer Lehr Divisions at Fresnay-sur-Sarthe came under fire, and both units withdrew to the north. Location: Fresnay-sur-Sarthe is named for the command post. Opponents: the two armored divisions of the U.S. XV Corps jumped off abreast; the 9th Panzer and 352d Divisions together claimed thirty-six tanks.
